sn55.46:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
sn55.46:2.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.46:2.3: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.46:2.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.46:2.7: imehi kho bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano”ti.
